title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 11.1 Voting Methods: Apply plurality voting to determine a winner.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 11.1 Voting Methods: Apply plurality voting to determine a winner.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "11.1 Voting Methods", prints these objectives: "Apply plurality voting to determine a winner." "Apply runoff voting to determine a winner." "Apply ranked-choice voting to determine a winner." "Apply Borda count voting to determine a winner." "Apply pairwise comparison and Condorcet voting to determine a winner." "Apply approval voting to determine a winner.". This card reports that page.
